description_en: Reruns downstream nodes to fix data link issues. Supports forced rerun of downstream nodes. Impact: incurs compute costs and affects data output
description_zh: 重跑下游(修复链路数据), 支持强制重跑下游；影响范围：会产生计算成本、影响数据产出
name: FixData

parameters.description_en: The command to rerun downstream nodes to fix data link issues. You can choose to force a rerun.
parameters.description_zh: 重跑下游(修复链路数据),可以选择强制重跑

fields.description_en: The field IDs. This parameter is available when the node is a logical table instance ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the full table is used by default.
fields.description_zh: 字段ID：当节点是逻辑表实例id时可以传，不传默认是全表
fields.help_en: The field IDs. This parameter is available when the node is a logical table instance ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the full table is used by default
fields.help_zh: 字段ID：当节点是逻辑表实例id时可以传，不传默认是全表
fields.name: field_instance_id_list

fields.description_en: The downstream instances. If you have specified a downstream range, you do not need to specify this parameter. Otherwise, you must specify the list of downstream instances.
fields.description_zh: 下游实例(如果选择了下游范围，则此处可不传，否则需要传入下游实例列表)
fields.help_en: The downstream instances. If you have specified a downstream range, you do not need to specify this parameter. Otherwise, you must specify the list of downstream instances
fields.help_zh: 下游实例(如果选择了下游范围，则此处可不传，否则需要传入下游实例列表)
fields.name: down_stream_instance_id_list

fields.description_en: Specifies whether to rerun the root instance. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is true.
fields.description_zh: 根实例是否重跑，不选默认为是
fields.help_en: Specifies whether to rerun the root instance. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is true
fields.help_zh: 根实例是否重跑，不选默认为是
fields.name: contain_root_instance

fields.description_en:
The downstream range. Valid values:
- ALL_FAILED_INSTANCE: all failed instances.
- ALL_INSTANCE: all instances.
- ALL_FINAL_INSTANCE: all desired state instances.
- If you do not specify this parameter, the rerun is performed based on the specified downstream instances.
fields.description_zh:
下游范围
- ALL_FAILED_INSTANCE:所有失败实例
- ALL_INSTANCE: 所有实例
- ALL_FINAL_INSTANCE: 所有终态实例
- 不传默认需要根据传入的下游进行重跑
